_provenance.what: Count of per-room areas actually PRINTED on each drawing, read by eye from F1_scaled.png.
_provenance.why: model.svg lists every annotated room, but its dimension labels are display:none and never rendered. Using the SVG room count as an area denominator therefore counts rooms whose area was never printed, understating recall. This file is the honest denominator.
_provenance.method: hand-verified, visual inspection of the rendered page
_provenance.scope: the 6 high_quality_architectural test plans used by eval/validate_ocr.py
_provenance.caveat: Hand counts by a single reader. Tier 4 re-verifies areas per room rather than per plan.
